vscodeVersion.comment: VS Code version hosting the extension.

remote.comment: Whether the extension host is local or remote.

uiKind.comment: Desktop or web VS Code UI.

usage.comment: Anonymous bounded action/outcome events, enabled only at VS Code telemetry level All and with overlyx.usageStatistics. Batched to /api/vscode-usage; no built-in common identifiers.

session.comment: Random activation or webview-load ID, never persisted.

detail.comment: Fixed action/outcome/state categories, or a scrubbed legacy command template.

where.comment: Coarse UI surface, never a document or file.

ago.comment: Bounded event age within this batch.

dt.comment: Duration bucket for diagnostics; bounded legacy dialog duration.

reliabilityConsent.comment: Separate explicit consent for beta reliability categories.

error.comment: A handled extension error shown to the user.

area.comment: Coarse extension subsystem in which the error occurred.

message.comment: Error message after VS Code telemetry sanitization.

stack.comment: Stack trace after VS Code telemetry sanitization.

unhandled-error.comment: An otherwise-unhandled error attributed by VS Code to the OverLyX extension.
